Title: A single-cell molecular map of mouse gastrulation and early organogenesis
Author: Pijuan-Sala, B.; Marioni, J.C.
Tissue: Whole embryo (E6.5–E8.5 gastrulation and early organogenesis)
Dataset ID: E-MTAB-6967 (atlas); E-MTAB-6970, E-MTAB-7324/7325 (chimera subsets); GSE87038 (myeloid annotation support only)
Comments: Tests how pluripotent epiblast cells diversify into all major embryonic lineages during gastrulation. Builds an in vivo molecular roadmap (~116k cells, nine time points) of differentiation trajectories (including visceral vs primitive-streak endoderm convergence) and uses Tal1-/- chimaeras to link gene function to early mesoderm diversification; baseline for mutant interpretation and optimisation of in vitro protocols.

Title: An integrated transcriptomic cell atlas of human endoderm-derived organoids
Author: Xu, Q.; Camp, J.G.
Technology: Integrated scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq (10x, Smart-seq, CEL-seq, Sort-seq)
Tissue: Endoderm-derived organoids (lung, intestine, liver, biliary, stomach, pancreas, prostate, salivary gland)
Dataset ID: HEOCA (CELLxGENE collection); GSE287233 (new intestine/stomach/liver organoid scRNA-seq)
Comments: Tests whether endoderm organoid protocols faithfully recapitulate primary fetal/adult endodermal cell states across organs and stem-cell sources. Constructs HEOCA (~1M cells, 218 samples, 54 datasets) to harmonise annotations, quantify on-/off-target fidelity, map new protocols, and use the atlas as a control cohort for perturbation and disease organoids (e.g. inflammation, CRC, COPD).

Title: An integrated transcriptomic cell atlas of human neural organoids
Author: He, Z.; Treutlein, B.
Tissue: Neural / brain organoids (guided and unguided protocols)
Comments: Tests which human brain regions and cell states existing neural-organoid protocols cover, and how closely they match developing primary brain references. Builds HNOCA (>1.7M cells; 36 datasets; 26 protocols) to quantify protocol fidelity/variation, annotate new datasets, and compare disease organoid models against a diverse healthy control atlas.

Title: Application of spatial transcriptomics across organoids: a high-resolution spatial whole-transcriptome benchmarking dataset
Author: Nucera, M.R.; Ramialison, M.
Tissue: Multi-organoid (brain, heart muscle/valve, kidney, lung, cartilage, haematopoietic) plus mouse reference tissues
Comments: Tests whether Stereo-seq can recover spatially organised, transcriptome-wide gene programmes across diverse stem-cell organoids at a resolution and capture depth comparable to in vivo tissues. Provides a cross-organoid spatial benchmarking resource (multi-sample chip optimisation, capture-efficiency limits vs reference tissues) and a region-based analysis framework (core vs border) when standard cell-type clustering is underpowered.

Title: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics reveal somitogenesis in gastruloids
Author: van den Brink, S.C.; van Oudenaarden, A.
Technology: scRNA-seq + tomo-seq (genome-wide A–P spatial RNA-seq) + live imaging
Tissue: Mouse gastruloids (and E8.5 embryo comparison); Matrigel-embedded somite-forming gastruloids
Comments: Tests whether gastruloids recapitulate embryo-like cell types and spatially organised somitogenesis programmes genome-wide (beyond marker imaging). Builds a gastruloid–embryo scRNA-seq and tomo-seq atlas of A–P gene expression, shows somitogenesis-clock activity in vitro, links reduced FGF signalling to short-tail phenotypes, and shows Matrigel embedding induces sequentially forming, correctly patterned somites.
